scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with clear rough edges; 10 exceptional and consistently effortless within assessed scope. Holistic judgment, not a win/loss grade or numerical average.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent atmospheric short mission with understandable objectives and effective touch assistance, tempered by moving-patrol targeting corrections and small distant targets.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag and scene turning responded, and anchored target taps corrected misses. Both perimeter moving bursts required a fresh-view correction. Pause lifecycle prevents judging sustained control comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, staged coil fight and deck upload supplied clear progression and combat decisions. Much traversal used assistance, leaving free navigation and broader combat depth uncertain.
reasons.presentation: Rain, wet-looking ground, cyan lighting and distinct industrial setting form a cohesive visual mood. This is visual presentation only; audio and hardware frame pacing not assessed.
reasons.usability: Large primary buttons, dynamic approach labels, map route selection and clear terminal breakdown were helpful. Several secondary controls remain unassessed.
reasons.readability: Objective, ammo, shield, threats and boss status were legible; distant patrol silhouettes, small signage and AIM badge overlap were harder to parse.

coverage: Opening guard: scene tap plus simultaneous manual MOVE and FIRE drag; TARGET DOWN.
Visible perimeter patrol: first left-edge tap and MOVE/FIRE drag showed no kill, ammo 21 to 20; fresh-view correction showed SENTINEL DOWN, ammo 18. Exact miss cause uncertain.
Assisted route and approach for three recoveries; coil taps with anchored FIRE; automatic reload observed; return and uplink.
failures: Initial deployment used visible Enter coordinate in an act with capture instead of required #deploy selector; preserved attempt without restart.
Coil III needed continuation after empty magazine; shield fell 60 to 41, later 15 during uplink.
helpful: Route, approach and threat direction cues
Map extraction selection and walking distance
frustrating: Dark coil machinery and AIM badge overlap

coverage: Opening guard: simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag after target tap; TARGET DOWN, ammo 30 to 21.
Perimeter patrol: simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag after left target tap; ammo 21 to 19, patrol still visible. Fresh-view correction with stationary anchored FIRE showed SENTINEL DOWN, ammo 18.

Assisted route/approach to all three recoveries; labeled coil target taps with stationary FIRE.

helpful: Fresh start visibly reset objectives and supplies

scores.scale: 0 unusable in observed scope; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic assessment of observed emulated portrait play, not a win/loss grade or physical-device certification. Overall is a judgment, not an arithmetic mean.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, attractive short mission with actionable touch assistance and clear progress. Portrait clutter, small scene labels and limited uninterrupted manual sampling temper confidence. Both wins are outcomes, not the reason for the grade.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE plus FIRE drag and scene turns worked in both attempts. Target taps and down feedback helpful. Continuous holding, rearming and physical-thumb comfort remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, patrol, coil and deck phases gave distinct observed tasks and feedback. Assisted traversal dominated; only brief manual fights, so depth, sustained challenge and long-session enjoyment cannot be graded confidently.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber sci-fi identity, rain, reflective floor, distinct weapon and terminal presentation. Some dark geometry and small in-world text reduce legibility. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Context-sensitive hold action, persistent objective/recovery checks, planning map route, and explicit terminal assist breakdown are helpful. Route and threat warnings compete in a narrow portrait layout.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo/objective and terminal stats readable; in-world signs, small coil numerals and secondary warnings require close inspection. Lower controls occupy considerable scene space.

coverage.manual_move_and_fire_drag: Opening guard and visible charging perimeter sentinel; simultaneous two-contact MOVE and FIRE drag. Both down feedback; patrol ammo 21 to 19, heading 269 to 264.
coverage.map: Opened return-to-deck map and visibly closed it
coverage.misses_and_corrections: No shot-level misses established; displayed 100% accuracy includes assistance. Turned left in response to front-left warning to locate patrol. Final coil depleted magazine at 26%; next FIRE contact completed reload and disabled it.

helpful: Opening tap-to-aim instruction immediately actionable; TARGET DOWN feedback explicit.
Front-left charge warning guided a scene turn to the visible perimeter sentinel.
Context action changed from HOLD ROUTE to HOLD APPROACH / HOLD TO RECOVER; recovery checkmarks made progress legible.
Planning map showed extraction route and obstacles; visibly closed before travel.
Separate coil percentages and OFF states, auto reload and upload percentage made progress clear.
frustrating: Small in-world lettering and low-contrast dark concrete landmarks at portrait width.
Patrol warning initially pointed off-screen, requiring turn and fresh observation.
Large lower controls occupy substantial portrait scene area.
Final coil remained at 26% when magazine emptied; another separated FIRE contact was required.
failures_and_uncertainties: No mission failure or retry occurred. Shot-level misses not established; displayed 100% accuracy is assisted.
Boss armor labels were present while coil damage occurred; paused captures do not establish exact shot/open-cycle timing.
No continuous hold, dash, jump, tools or zoom assessment.
Final preterminal live view: health 100, shield 32, ammo 25/330; terminal UI does not report final health.

attempts.fresh_start: Visible START FRESH via #play-again in act with capture; initial health 100, shield 60, ammo 30/180 and unchecked recoveries. No checkpoint retry.

coverage.manual_move_and_fire_drag: Opening guard: target tap plus two-contact MOVE and FIRE drag, TARGET DOWN, ammo 30 to 21. Visible left-edge perimeter sentinel: target tap at 0.062/0.522 plus MOVE drag toward 0.28/0.89 and FIRE drag to 0.55/0.86; SENTINEL DOWN, ammo 21 to 19. Assistance active, not pure drag-aim accuracy.
coverage.scene_turn: Short right scene swipe changed heading 259 to 278; viewed resulting capture before continuation.
coverage.other_combat: Visible east-route sentinel tapped and fired, ammo 19 to 17 with SENTINEL DOWN. Three coils disabled, then three separate deck target/fire batches.
coverage.misses_and_corrections: Terminal 93% accuracy establishes misses in aggregate, but no shot-level miss count/location or corrective aim can be established. Final coil at 47% when magazine emptied; next FIRE batch reloaded and reduced it to 15% with COIL III ARMOR feedback; following FIRE batch disabled it.

helpful: Prior learning made context-action prompts and coil OFF feedback familiar.
Visible sentinel silhouette/target brackets supported a left-edge engagement.
Ammo/reload text clearly explained interruption; coil percentages showed remaining work.
Upload percentage and STAY ON DECK instruction gave a clear final task.
frustrating: Incoming fire from off-screen while recovering; red edge cue and rear/left warnings required attention outside current objective.
Dark similar structures and small labels made assisted route markers valuable but independent navigation less well sampled.
Controls and warnings consume much of the bottom portrait area.
failures_and_uncertainties: No mission loss, checkpoint retry or uplink retry.
Aggregate misses preserved as 93%; do not infer which shots missed.
Shield visibly fell to 18 by final deck combat; last live screenshot health 100, ammo 21/330. Terminal does not display final health.
One capture (attempt2-recover2) visibly showed shield 41 while beforePause text reported 60: capture timing differs; image observation preserved.

status: Two sequential fresh reviewers; four wins; both overall7. No quality certification.
